games.purpose: Third-person beacon, key and checkpoint adventure
games.notes: Replaced ribbon and primitive scenery with ranger, guardian, three beacon courts, connected stone causeway, woods, ruins and sanctuary. Fixed floor lips, authored long-level bounds, fall-to-checkpoint recovery and key-dependent win. Normal play lit all three  beacons, collected Vale Key, won at29.61 simulated seconds with 94 HP, and restarted.
games.remainingGaps: Compact sample depth; repeated arches and flat open expanses keep it below Featured. The 5–10 minute fantasy flagship ambition still needs richer pacing and bespoke art.

games.purpose: Relay objectives with first-person drone combat
games.notes: Built a readable panelled communications facility with original terminals, drones, weapon, warning accents and ambient/effect audio. Camera-aligned shooting, restore three relays, extraction and native Restart verified. Final normal win34.57 sim/79 HP; actual wall collision retains invisible body and visible gun.
games.remainingGaps: Sparse industrial rooms and near-black surfaces limit visual depth. Drone combat and relay feedback are suitable for a focused sample.

games.purpose: Weapon switching, reload and compact arena combat
games.notes: Added deliberate cover lanes, original rifle/sidearm visuals, drone silhouettes, projectile/impact feedback and combat audio. Extraction now requires three defeats. Normal win40.51 sim/60 HP, reload/switch, Pause, intentional loss and native Restarts verified.
games.remainingGaps: Arena remains small and visually repetitive. Finer recoil, animation, surface detail and encounter pacing would be needed for Featured.

games.purpose: Stealth perception, hearing and cover-based infiltration
games.notes: Retained intro camera, patrol/perception/hearing/Investigate and objective chain; authored machinery cover, readable Data Core, extraction lighting and alert/ambient sound. Crouched north-cover route, Data pickup, all three objectives and extraction won30.72 sim with native Restart. A later screenshot route lost normally after lingering near guards, and also restarted.
games.remainingGaps: Facility is sparse and some surfaces remain dark. More explicit patrol feedback and varied cover encounters would improve the stealth experience.

games.purpose: Carry interactions and a multi-stage machinery puzzle
games.notes: Added generator machinery, cell, coolant consoles, pipes, route strips and ambient zones. Opened the formerly blocked coolant passage and fixed held-cell interaction priority; power plus both coolant switches control the exit. Full normal-input win recorded, with cell carried/consumed and gate/extraction progression. Latest framed replay won at 23.30 simulation seconds and native Restart passed.
games.remainingGaps: A coherent compact puzzle sample; broad bare surfaces, basic console feedback and limited puzzle complexity keep it below Featured.

games.purpose: Terrain exploration, relic collection and a keyed shrine
games.notes: Added ranger, relic landmarks, trees/rocks/ruins/shrine, deliberate lighting, lava material and meaningful pickup/ending sound. Kept the three-relic/key/lever loop, grounded the player and moved health away from the objective. Normal route collectedthree relics and key, used lever, won at the shrine and restarted. One-shot pickup destruction prevents hidden relics from incrementing the counter again.
games.remainingGaps: Small collection loop with sparse terrain and repeated kit motifs; correctly scoped as a sample, not a flagship.
